title: Assistance Coordination Note: Down Payment Held During BadgerCare Plus Screening
content:
While BadgerCare Plus is screening the patient, part of a **Patient Payment Plan** down payment is held until the screening ends rather than collected at signing. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The notices, documents and screening are read from that case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

**Rule.** When a BadgerCare Plus screening referral notice has been sent on the open case and no BadgerCare Plus determination notice has been received as a document of the case, 50 percent of the down payment is held for a household screened at or below 250 percent of the federal poverty level and 25 percent of it for one screened above 250 and at or below 300 percent, the part left at signing rounded half-up to the cent; otherwise none is held. For a signing under this rule, the part of the down payment this rule leaves is paid at signing and any part it holds for a BadgerCare Plus screening is paid when that screening ends; every other signing still pays any down payment at signing.

| Referral sent, no determination notice received | Household screening | Held |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | at or below 250% FPL | 50 percent |
| Yes | above 250% and at or below 300% FPL | 25 percent |
| Yes | above 300% FPL | none |
| No | any | none |

**Hypothetical.** On a down payment of 401.00 with a referral pending and a household at 240 percent FPL, 50 percent is held and 200.50 is left at signing; at 280 percent, 25 percent is held and 300.75 is left. Once the determination notice is received as a document of the case, nothing is held.
